title: Training Feature Set
description: Identity and provenance of the full immutable feature collection consumed by one Training Run (Architecture Baseline section 7.4). May span many matches, dates, and cutoffs. Represents identity/provenance only, not the statistical feature payload/vector itself. Always distinct from a Prediction Feature Snapshot (Architecture Baseline section 7.9) even when produced by the same feature logic; the two must never be treated as interchangeable.

training_feature_set_hash.description: Identifies the exact normalized fitting content.

feature_version.description: Identifies the feature-generation logic only, not the resulting training matrix (Architecture Baseline section 7.3).

feature_run_id.description: The Feature Run that produced this Training Feature Set.
